meta.source: evolution-mobile src/theme (colors.ts, status.ts, typography.ts, layout.ts) and the 3VOtech logo studies, 2026-10-13

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Screen background, behind grouped content. Dark is deep navy, never black.

tokens.name: cell
tokens.usage: Grouped cells and cards that sit on ground.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Control backgrounds: search fields, segmented tracks, add tiles.

tokens.name: fillStrong
tokens.usage: A selected segment, or a fill that must stand out from fill.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, cell and fill (16:1 or better in both themes). Also the logo's TECH and its one-color navy version.

tokens.name: label2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: subtitles, counts, metadata. 5.3:1 on ground and 4.7:1 on fill in light; 7:1 or better in dark.

tokens.name: label3
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled text only. 2.8:1 in light and 4.4:1 in dark, below the 4.5:1 body text needs, so never use it for content someone must read.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows.

tokens.name: pill
tokens.usage: The translucent pill behind a selected item on glass, tab-bar style.

tokens.name: glassTint
tokens.usage: Tint for our own glass surfaces: the ground color, part-transparent, kept light so it reads like the system tab bar.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Volt Blue. Anything you tap: buttons, selection, links. Text in tint reads 5:1 or better on ground and cell in both themes. The Ǝ in the logo.

tokens.name: onTint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a tint fill. 5.5:1 in light. Dark is 3.1:1, kept white to match how iOS draws a prominent button; fine for 17pt semibold button labels, too low for small text. Deepen dark tint before changing this.

tokens.name: tintSoft
tokens.usage: A tint-tinted background: selected tab, tinted buttons. Translucent.

tokens.name: tintContainer
tokens.usage: An opaque tinted surface that floats over content (Material's primary container).

tokens.name: onTintContainer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tintContainer (9.7:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ultraviolet. Brand moments only: the logo's V, progress. 5.2:1 or better on ground in both themes. Never a tappable control; that is tint.

tokens.name: spark
tokens.usage: Spark Cyan. Anything live: scanning, syncing, checked in. The logo's O. In light it is 3.4:1 on ground, so use it for icons, marks and text 24px or larger there; dark is 10:1.

tokens.name: sparkSoft
tokens.usage: A spark-tinted background behind live state.

tokens.name: sparkContainer
tokens.usage: An opaque spark surface, such as a checked-in banner.

tokens.name: onSparkContainer
tokens.usage: Text and icons on sparkContainer (9.6:1 light, 7.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and errors. Light reads 4.8:1 on cell but 4.4:1 on ground, so set small danger text on cell. Always pair it with a word or icon.

tokens.name: dangerSoft
tokens.usage: Issue chip background; danger text sits on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done. Text in success reads 5:1 light, 10:1 dark. Always with a word or icon, never hue alone.

tokens.name: successSoft
tokens.usage: Done chip background; success text sits on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: In progress, needs attention. 5:1 light, 10:1 dark.

tokens.name: warningSoft
tokens.usage: In-progress chip background; warning text sits on it.

tokens.name: logo-e
tokens.usage: The Ǝ in the logo. Use the logo files rather than redrawing; this names the color for print and vendors.

tokens.name: logo-v
tokens.usage: The V, the check mark, in the logo.

tokens.name: logo-o
tokens.usage: The O in the logo.

tokens.name: logo-ink
tokens.usage: TECH in the logo, and the one-color logo on light grounds.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Pending, and any status the backend sends that the app does not know. The only status fill that changes with the theme.

tokens.name: status-pending-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-pending.

tokens.name: status-in-progress
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: In Progress.

tokens.name: status-in-progress-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-in-progress.

tokens.name: status-completed
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Completed. Also a finished task's mark.

tokens.name: status-completed-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-completed.

tokens.name: status-issue
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Issue.

tokens.name: status-issue-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-issue.

tokens.name: status-dnd
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Do Not Disturb. Magenta, so it never reads as the accent purple.

tokens.name: status-dnd-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-dnd.

tokens.name: status-checked-in
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Checked In. Cyan, so it never reads as a selected tint control.

tokens.name: status-checked-in-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-checked-in.

tokens.name: status-locked
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Locked.

tokens.name: status-locked-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-locked.

tokens.name: status-deleted
tokens.usage: Room tile fill: Deleted.

tokens.name: status-deleted-on
tokens.usage: Room number on status-deleted.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Saira at 125% width (Saira Expanded), caps, tracked wide. The logo's TECH is outlined artwork with cut ends; use the logo files, and this style only to match it in live type, such as a heading on a web page.

styles.name: ios-headline
styles.usage: variant="headline". Row titles that need weight.

styles.name: ios-body
styles.sample: Check in to start this room.

styles.name: android-body
styles.sample: Check in to start this room.
styles.usage: variant="body". No letterSpacing: React Native measures spaced text wider than Android draws it.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: spacing.xs. Use the nearest step; an odd value needs a comment saying why.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: spacing.sm.

tokens.name: space-ms
tokens.usage: spacing.ms. Row padding, gaps inside a group.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: spacing.md.

tokens.name: space-ml
tokens.usage: spacing.ml. Floating chrome inset from the screen edge.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: spacing.lg.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: spacing.xl.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: spacing.xxl.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: radius.control. Text fields and small controls. Android 8px.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: radius.tile. Room tiles and photo thumbnails. Android 16px.

tokens.name: radius-cell
tokens.usage: radius.cell. Grouped list sections and cards. Android 16px. Pair with borderCurve continuous on iOS.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: radius.full. Capsules: buttons, chips, search fields.

tokens.name: min-touch
tokens.usage: minTouch. Smallest tap target: 44pt on iOS (Apple HIG), 48dp on Android (Material).
